name: Alcolea de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcolea de Calatrava (a castle on red and a mount).
history: Municipal flag of Alcolea de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcolea de Calatrava arms — castle and mount
